children.text: Conversation 1: Meimei and Peter
Hello, I'm Song Meimei. May I have your name?
children.cn: 你好，我是宋美美。请问你叫什么名字？
children.speaker: Meimei
children.notes: May I have your name?: 请问你叫什么名字？
children.statement: 美美首先向对方作自我介绍并询问姓名。
children.explanation: 美美说'Hello, I'm Song Meimei. May I have your name?'。

children.text: Hi, I'm Peter Brown. Nice to meet you.
children.cn: 你好，我是彼得·布朗。很高兴见到你。
children.speaker: Peter
children.notes: Nice to meet you: 很高兴见到你
children.statement: 彼得的全名是彼得·布朗。
children.explanation: 彼得回答'Hi, I'm Peter Brown.'。
children.keywords: Peter Brown, Nice to meet you

children.text: Nice to meet you too. How do you spell your name?
children.cn: 我也很高兴见到你。你的名字怎么拼写？
children.speaker: Meimei
children.notes: How do you spell...?: ...怎么拼写？
children.statement: 美美询问彼得如何拼写他的名字。
children.explanation: 美美问'How do you spell your name?'。

children.text: P-E-T-E-R, Peter. B-R-O-W-N, Brown.
children.speaker: Peter
children.notes: 拼写姓名字母
children.statement: 彼得拼写出了自己的名字和姓氏。
children.explanation: 彼得逐字拼写了P-E-T-E-R和B-R-O-W-N。

children.text: Where are you from?
children.speaker: Meimei
children.notes: Where are you from?: 你来自哪里？
children.statement: 美美在询问彼得来自哪个国家或地区。
children.explanation: 美美用'Where are you from?'询问对方来源地。

children.text: I'm from London, in the UK.
children.speaker: Peter
children.notes: from London, in the UK: 来自英国伦敦
children.statement: 彼得来自美国。
children.explanation: 彼得说他来自英国伦敦（London, in the UK）。

children.text: Wow, that's far. What class are you in?
children.cn: 哇，那很远。你在哪个班级？
children.speaker: Meimei
children.notes: that's far: 那很远；What class: 哪个班级
children.statement: 美美接着询问彼得在哪个班级。
children.explanation: 美美问'What class are you in?'。

children.text: I'm in Class 1, Grade 7.
children.speaker: Peter
children.notes: Class 1, Grade 7: 七年级一班
children.statement: 彼得在七年级二班。
children.explanation: 彼得明确说明自己在Class 1, Grade 7（七年级一班）。

children.text: Wow, we're in the same class!
children.speaker: Meimei
children.notes: in the same class: 在同一个班级
children.statement: 美美和彼得不在同一个班级。
children.explanation: 美美高兴地指出'we're in the same class!'（我们在同一个班级）。

children.text: Conversation 2: Ella and Ms Li
Good morning, Ms Li.
children.speaker: Ella
children.notes: Good morning: 早上好
children.statement: 埃拉向李老师问好。
children.explanation: 埃拉说'Good morning, Ms Li.'。

children.text: Good morning! Are you Emma?
children.speaker: Ms Li
children.notes: Are you...?: 你是...吗？
children.statement: 李老师把埃拉误认成了埃玛。
children.explanation: 李老师问'Are you Emma?'，以为她是埃玛。

children.text: No, Ms Li. I'm Ella.
children.speaker: Ella
children.notes: I'm Ella: 我是埃拉
children.statement: 她的名字叫埃玛。
children.explanation: 她纠正说'No, Ms Li. I'm Ella.'。

children.text: Sorry, Ella. What's your last name?
children.cn: 对不起，埃拉。你的姓氏是什么？
children.speaker: Ms Li
children.notes: last name: 姓氏
children.statement: 李老师表达歉意并询问埃拉的姓氏。
children.explanation: 李老师说'Sorry, Ella. What's your last name?'。

children.text: It's Miller.
children.speaker: Ella
children.notes: Miller: 米勒（姓氏）
children.statement: 埃拉的姓氏是史密斯（Smith）。
children.explanation: 埃拉明确回答'It's Miller.'。

children.text: How old are you, Ella?
children.speaker: Ms Li
children.notes: How old are you?: 你几岁了？
children.statement: 李老师询问埃拉的年龄。
children.explanation: 李老师问'How old are you, Ella?'。

children.text: I'm 12 years old.
children.speaker: Ella
children.notes: 12 years old: 12岁
children.statement: 埃拉今年13岁。
children.explanation: 埃拉回答'I'm 12 years old.'。

children.text: Well, it's nice to meet you.
children.speaker: Ms Li
children.notes: nice to meet you: 很高兴认识你
children.statement: 李老师向埃拉致以问候。
children.explanation: 李老师说'Well, it's nice to meet you.'。

children.text: Nice to meet you too.
children.speaker: Ella
children.notes: Nice to meet you too: 我也很高兴认识你
children.statement: 埃拉礼貌地回应李老师。
children.explanation: 埃拉用'Nice to meet you too.'进行礼貌回应。

children.text: Hello, Mr Smith!
children.speaker: Chen Jie
children.notes: Mr Smith: 史密斯先生
children.statement: 陈杰向史密斯老师打招呼。
children.explanation: 陈杰说'Hello, Mr Smith!'。

children.text: Hello, Chen Jie. How are you?
children.speaker: Mr Smith
children.notes: How are you?: 你好吗？
children.statement: 史密斯老师询问陈杰近况。
children.explanation: 史密斯老师问'How are you?'。

children.text: I'm good, thank you. Mr Smith, this is my new friend, Peter. Peter, this is our English teacher, Mr Smith. He's from the US.
children.cn: 我挺好的，谢谢您。史密斯先生，这是我的新朋友彼得。彼得，这是我们的英语老师史密斯先生。他来自美国。
children.speaker: Chen Jie
children.notes: this is...: 这是...（介绍他人）；from the US: 来自美国
children.statement: 史密斯老师来自英国。
children.explanation: 陈杰明确说明史密斯老师来自美国（from the US）。
children.keywords: good, friend Peter, English teacher, US
children.highlight: I'm good, this is, English teacher, from the US

children.text: Hi, Peter. Nice to meet you.
children.speaker: Mr Smith
children.notes: Nice to meet you: 很高兴见到你
children.statement: 史密斯老师向彼得问好。
children.explanation: 史密斯老师说'Hi, Peter. Nice to meet you.'。

children.text: Nice to meet you too, Mr Smith.
children.cn: 我也很高兴见到您，史密斯先生。
children.speaker: Peter
children.notes: Nice to meet you too: 我也很高兴见到您
children.statement: 彼得礼貌地回应史密斯老师。
children.explanation: 彼得回答'Nice to meet you too, Mr Smith.'。

children.text: What class are you in, Peter?
children.speaker: Mr Smith
children.notes: What class are you in?: 你在哪个班级？
children.statement: 史密斯老师询问彼得所在的班级。
children.explanation: 史密斯老师问'What class are you in, Peter?'。

children.text: I'm in Class 1.
children.speaker: Peter
children.notes: Class 1: 一班
children.statement: 彼得在二班。
children.explanation: 彼得说'I'm in Class 1.'（在一班）。

children.text: Who's your class teacher?
children.speaker: Mr Smith
children.notes: Who's...: 谁是...；class teacher: 班主任
children.statement: 史密斯老师询问彼得的班主任是谁。
children.explanation: 史密斯老师问'Who's your class teacher?'。

children.text: Ms Hui.
children.speaker: Peter
children.notes: Ms Hui: 惠老师
children.statement: 彼得认为他的班主任姓惠。
children.explanation: 彼得直接回答'Ms Hui.'。

children.text: Oh, Peter, it's Ms Gao, not Ms Hui. Hui is her first name.
children.cn: 哦，彼得，是高老师，不是惠老师。惠是她的名字。
children.speaker: Chen Jie
children.notes: first name: 名字（名）
children.statement: 彼得的班主任实际上姓高，'惠'是她的名字。
children.explanation: 陈杰纠正说'it's Ms Gao, not Ms Hui. Hui is her first name.'。
children.highlight: it's Ms, not Ms, first name

children.text: Oh, sorry! My mistake.
children.speaker: Peter
children.notes: My mistake: 我的失误/弄错了
children.statement: 彼得承认了自己搞错了班主任的姓氏。
children.explanation: 彼得道歉并说'My mistake.'。

children.text: Pauline Lee
Hi, I'm Pauline Lee, and I'm 14 years old.
children.cn: 嗨，我是保利娜·李，我14岁了。
children.notes: 14 years old: 14岁
children.statement: 保利娜·李今年14岁。
children.explanation: 文章写道'I'm Pauline Lee, and I'm 14 years old.'。

children.text: I live in Singapore with my big family.
children.cn: 我和我的大家庭一起生活在新加坡。
children.notes: live in: 住在...；big family: 大家庭
children.statement: 保利娜住在英国。
children.explanation: 保利娜说她住在新加坡（live in Singapore）。

children.text: I have a pet bird. It's a parrot.
children.cn: 我有一只宠物鸟。是一只鹦鹉。
children.notes: pet bird: 宠物鸟；parrot: 鹦鹉
children.statement: 保利娜养了一只宠物猫。
children.explanation: 保利娜养的是宠物鸟（鹦鹉），不是猫。
children.highlight: have a, pet bird, It's a

children.text: Her name is Coco. She even speaks some Chinese!
children.cn: 它的名字叫Coco。它甚至还会说一些中文！
children.notes: speaks Chinese: 说中文；even: 甚至
children.statement: 鹦鹉Coco甚至能说一点中文。
children.explanation: 文中提到'She even speaks some Chinese!'。

children.text: My favourite sport is tennis.
children.cn: 我最喜欢的运动是网球。
children.notes: favourite sport: 最喜欢的运动；tennis: 网球
children.statement: 保利娜最喜欢的运动是足球。
children.explanation: 她最喜欢的运动是网球（tennis）。

children.text: I often play it with my friends after school.
children.cn: 放学后我经常和朋友们一起打网球。
children.notes: often: 经常；after school: 放学后
children.statement: 保利娜经常在放学后和朋友打网球。
children.explanation: 文中写道'I often play it with my friends after school.'。
children.highlight: often play, with my, after school

children.text: Do you want to be my friend?
children.notes: want to be: 想成为
children.statement: 保利娜在文章结尾表达了想交朋友的愿望。
children.explanation: 保利娜问'Do you want to be my friend?'。
children.highlight: Do you, want to, my friend

children.text: Peter Brown
Hey there! My name is Peter Brown. I'm 13 years old.
children.cn: 嗨！我的名字叫彼得·布朗。我13岁了。
children.notes: Hey there: 大家好/嗨
children.statement: 彼得·布朗今年13岁。
children.explanation: 彼得说'My name is Peter Brown. I'm 13 years old.'。
children.highlight: Hey there, My name, years old

children.text: I'm from London, in the UK.
children.notes: from London, in the UK: 来自英国伦敦
children.statement: 彼得来自英国伦敦。
children.explanation: 彼得明确指出'I'm from London, in the UK.'。

children.text: Now, I live in Beijing with my family.
children.cn: 现在，我和家人住在北京。
children.notes: live in Beijing: 住在北京
children.statement: 彼得现在和家人住在北京。
children.explanation: 彼得说'Now, I live in Beijing with my family.'。

children.text: My favourite food is Beijing roast duck, and my favourite place is the Great Wall.
children.cn: 我最喜欢的食物是北京烤鸭，我最的地方是长城。
children.notes: Beijing roast duck: 北京烤鸭；the Great Wall: 长城
children.statement: 彼得最喜欢的食物是麻婆豆腐。
children.explanation: 彼得最喜欢的食物是北京烤鸭（Beijing roast duck）。
children.keywords: food roast duck, place Great Wall
children.highlight: favourite food, favourite place, Great Wall

children.text: I like music, and I play the guitar in the school band.
children.cn: 我喜欢音乐，我在学校乐队里弹吉他。
children.notes: play the guitar: 弹吉他；school band: 学校乐队
children.statement: 彼得在学校乐队里弹吉他。
children.explanation: 文中写道'I play the guitar in the school band.'。
children.keywords: like music, play guitar, school band
children.highlight: like music, play the guitar, school band

children.text: Would you like to be my friend?
children.cn: 你愿意成为我的朋友吗？
children.notes: Would you like to...?: 你愿意...吗？
children.statement: 彼得表达了希望能与读者成为朋友。
children.explanation: 彼得问'Would you like to be my friend?'。
children.highlight: Would you, like to be, my friend

children.text: me
My name is Andre Kalu.
children.cn: 我的名字叫安德烈·卡卢。
children.notes: Andre Kalu: 安德烈·卡卢（人名）
children.statement: 作者的名字叫安德烈·卡卢。
children.explanation: 文中写道'My name is Andre Kalu.'。

children.text: I'm 13 years old.
children.notes: 13 years old: 13岁
children.statement: 安德烈今年14岁。
children.explanation: 安德烈说自己13岁（I'm 13 years old）。

children.text: I'm from South Africa, but now I live in China.
children.cn: 我来自南非，但现在我住在中国。
children.notes: South Africa: 南非；live in China: 住在中国
children.statement: 安德烈来自南非，目前在中国生活。
children.explanation: 安德烈写道'I'm from South Africa, but now I live in China.'。
children.highlight: from South Africa, but now, live in

children.text: my family
I live with my father, my mother, and my brother.
children.cn: 我和我爸爸、妈妈还有哥哥（弟弟）住在一起。
children.notes: live with: 与...同住
children.statement: 安德烈独自一人在中国生活。
children.explanation: 安德烈和父母及兄弟住在一起。

children.text: We have a pet cat.
children.notes: pet cat: 宠物猫
children.statement: 安德烈家里养了一只宠物猫。
children.explanation: 文中说'We have a pet cat.'。

children.text: His name is Toby.
children.notes: His name: 它的名字
children.statement: 宠物猫的名字叫Coco。
children.explanation: 猫的名字是Toby（His name is Toby）。

children.text: favourites
My favourite food is beef noodles.
children.cn: 我最喜欢的食物是牛肉面。
children.notes: beef noodles: 牛肉面
children.statement: 安德烈最喜欢的食物是牛肉面。
children.explanation: 文中写道'My favourite food is beef noodles.'。

children.text: My favourite sport is basketball.
children.cn: 我最喜欢的运动是篮球。
children.notes: basketball: 篮球
children.statement: 安德烈最喜欢的运动是乒乓球。
children.explanation: 安德烈最喜欢的运动是篮球（basketball）。

children.text: I play basketball every weekend with my brother and my friends.
children.cn: 我每个周末都和我的兄弟以及朋友们一起打篮球。
children.notes: every weekend: 每个周末；play basketball: 打篮球
children.statement: 安德烈每个周末都和兄弟及朋友打篮球。
children.explanation: 文中提到'I play basketball every weekend with my brother and my friends.'。
